The '''Krath Council''' was the governing body of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], most likely based on the concept of a [[Sith Council]]. As leaders of the Krath, [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal]] and [[Aleema Keto]] were the heads of the Council.
